QuestInfo.name: Costume Preparation
QuestInfo.0: Lala is thrilled to hear that Blake is finally making his debut and happily agrees to help with the costumes. Assist #bLala#k to prepare the costumes.
QuestInfo.1: Bring the costumes for Blake's debut performance to #bLala#k. The mannequins on the #r5th-6th Floors of Kerning Square#k should have all the costumes and props he'll need.
QuestInfo.2: #bLala#k was thrilled to hear about Blake's debut and asked you to give her some time to think about which costumes would be best for the performance.
QuestInfo.rewardSummary: EXP 7,800\nCan proceed to the Costume Preparation, Done! quest\n

0.0: Hey! You're back! I've decided on Blake's costume. But I'm a student, so I don't have much free time to work on the costume. Can you help me collect the materials I need?

yes.0: A rad fedora is what you're missing. Oh, and a wig! And a cute bunny hat! That'll be the best! I bet you can get all that stuff on the #r5th-6th Floors of Kerning Square#k! The mannequins up there have great style! Make sure to bring enough for the backup dancers too, okay?
yes.1: Please bring me #b20 Kid Mannequin Bunny Suits, 20 Female Mannequin Wigs, and 20 Male Mannequin Fedoras#k.

no.0: Blake can't have a debut performance without the right costume. This is important!

1.0: Woohoo! Have you brought the materials? Let me see, let me see. I'm so excited!

yes.0: Eeeek, they're wonderful! Everything from Bunny Suits to Fedoras! It's everything I could've asked for! But...something is missing. Argh, I can't quite figure it out. Could you talk to me in a little bit? I need to think this through.

item.0: Please bring me #b20 Kid Mannequin Bunny Suits, 20 Female Mannequin Wigs, and 20 Male Mannequin Fedoras#k. You'll be able to find them easily on the 5th-6th floor of Kerning Square.
